notes.title: 🧟‍♂️ The Zombies Are Coming... With a Killer Discount! 🧟‍♂️
notes.content:
Survivors, brace yourselves! The Steam Autumn Sale kicks off on November 27, and Zombie Survivor: Undead City Attack is dropping with a spine-tingling deal you can’t resist! 🍂💀

💥 What’s waiting for you?

 Intense, action-packed zombie battles.
 Brutal weapons to unleash your fury.
 Endless hordes to test your survival skills.

🛒 Why wait? This is your chance to grab the ultimate undead experience at a scarily low price!

📅 Mark the date. Save the city. Don’t miss the sale.
